VLT da Baixada Santista light rail, Santos/São Vicente metro area (BR). route_type=0 (tram/LRT).

STATION LIST (evidenced): Linha 1 = 15 stations Barreiros<->Porto, confirmed identically by EN + PT Wikipedia in order: Barreiros, Mascarenhas de Moraes, São Vicente, Antônio Emmerich, Nossa Senhora das Graças, José Monteiro, Itararé, João Ribeiro, Nossa Senhora de Lourdes, Pinheiro Machado, Bernardino de Campos, Ana Costa, Washington Luís, Conselheiro Nébias, Porto (11.5 km). Linha 2 (Valongo extension) = 12 additional stations, operating as a one-way directional LOOP from Conselheiro Nébias: outbound Xavier Pinheiro, Universidades I, Mercado, Paquetá, Poupatempo, Mauá, Valongo; return José Bonifácio, Bittencourt, Campos Sales, Universidades II, Carvalho de Mendonça -> back to Conselheiro Nébias. Note: prompt said Valongo opened Dec-2025; WebSearch (guiaamosantos) indicates the extension reached full operation 11 May 2026. Both Wikipedia and the Amo Santos guide agree on the 12-station loop names.

SCHEDULE (evidenced): PT Wikipedia + EMTU/guides give operating span 05:30-23:30 daily; Linha 1 headway ~10 min, Linha 2 loop headway ~20 min. No published clock timetable per stop was accessible (EMTU timetable is behind a "linha 953" query form; Moovit page returned no content), so per-stop times are MODELED at even headway across the service span with ~2.5 min hops (Line 1, 15 stops ~= 40 min end-to-end) / ~3 min hops (Line 2 loop, ~40 min cycle) and 20 s dwell. Times are realistic estimates, not the operator's exact published minutes.

COORDINATES: Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (IPv6-only route refused; all mirrors failed) and Nominatim rate-limited (HTTP 429) after a burst, so precise OSM tram_stop coords could NOT be pulled. The Valongo neighborhood anchor (-23.9347,-46.3341) WAS confirmed via Nominatim. All 27 stop_lat/stop_lon are CURATED WGS-84 estimates placed along the documented alignment (Av. Martins Fontes -> Av. Pres. Wilson beachfront -> Av. Ana Costa -> Av. Conselheiro Nébias -> Centro/Valongo) from known Santos/São Vicente street geography; accurate to ~50-150 m but not surveyed. This is the main confidence drag.

REPRESENTATIVE TRIPS: To keep the payload compact, this feed emits representative trips at 05:30 / 12:00 / 23:00 for each direction (Line 1 both ways, Line 2 loop) with full ordered stop_times on the 05:30 trips and terminus-only samples on the midday/late trips to demonstrate the headway pattern. The generator (/tmp/build_gtfs.py) produces the full 273-trip / 4040-stop_time daily feed at real 10 min / 20 min headways across 05:30-23:30.

confidence 0.55: station names + order + line topology are well-evidenced and correct; operating span + headways are evidenced; but per-stop clock times are modeled and coordinates are curated estimates (Overpass/Nominatim blocked), not surveyed OSM data.
